d: Straight, shoulder-length pale blue hair with blunt-cut bangs and a slight cowlick. Sharp, narrow pale blue eyes with a neutral, stoic expression on a youthful, adolescent face. A slender build wearing a white short-sleeved collared shirt, a gold neck-bow, a dark charcoal grey sleeveless vest, and a matching pleated charcoal grey mini-skirt with a tan belt. Accessories include white gloves and a dark brown strap across the torso.
